llm.summary: This skill is a small, non-executable self-improvement prompt package with no evidence of hidden commands, network use, credential access, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is privacy-first, consent-based self-improvement for AI agents, and the artifact only describes local learning capture and suggestions; no code or operational mechanism is included.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The keyword list includes broad terms like learning, privacy, and best-practices, which could cause over-broad skill routing, but this is a discoverability/scope issue rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md and skill.json, with no install script, executable file, dependency installation, or post-install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact requests no apparent filesystem, network, credential, shell, or external service authority beyond normal skill text being read by an agent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The text advertises auto-capturing learnings and local-only storage, but the package contains no implementation or explicit persistence path; users should ensure any memory capture remains consent-based.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that the skill is meant to influence how an agent records and reuses learning. Keep it enabled only where local memory capture is desired, and prefer explicit invocation if your environment routes skills by generic keywords.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad keywords are present and could increase accidental invocation, but the artifact is otherwise coherent, non-executable, and purpose-aligned, so this does not justify Review by itself.
